title: 00_041 — dir/ROOT/Hunter/boxing/

features.name: record 00_041
features.desc-on-touch: Scanned from a box found behind a foreclosed gymnasium. The man who took admission at the fights later kept the municipal pool.

features.name: record 00_042
features.desc-on-touch: The names he was sold under, each with its own fights. None of these is the name he was born with.

features.name: the line beneath the three names
features.desc-on-touch: There is another name beneath these, printed in the same type as the hall and the weight at which he fought. Nobody typed it. This shell will not draw it. Leave it where it is.

features.name: a notebook on a steering wheel
features.desc-on-touch: She had come to surpass his predilection for local history with a fervour he had not seen coming. She spins a piece of amber between her fingers as she reads.

inscription: the name was birthed online of its own making

file.name: hunter_north.txt
file.note: Fight history for the region. One line of this file was not uploaded by anyone.
